results.title: A verse's content from the verse bar
results.checks: On Isaiah 40, tap verse 3 → the verse bar offers Content → 'Content for Isaiah 40:3': In the Dead Sea Scrolls (each copy's Hebrew and English draft), Quoted in other writings (the Community Rule, found by computer), Quoted in the New Testament (Matthew 3:3 … — tapping one opens it), In Greek (the Septuagint) and the sources' credits; at Genesis 1:3 a scroll line that runs on from verse 2 says 'This line holds Genesis 1:2–3', after the lines that start at verse 3; on John 11, verse 35 has none and the bar does not offer Content
results.note: Isaiah 40:3: 5 scroll lines (Hebrew "[ ב מדבר פנו דרך…"), Community Rule, Matthew 3:3 opened, Greek; John 11:35: not offered
